title: Items waiting on a person's placement
description: What GET /api/v1/review answers and `ingestion review list --json` prints: each item that waits on a person, oldest first: one that no tag, rule or confident guess placed, or one that holds no usable parse. POST /api/v1/review/{key}/place takes one of the destinations the destinations file names.

reason.description: Why the item waits: its sightings' tags disagree, the guess fell below the floor, or it has no usable parse.

guess.description: The quality gate's guess, shown where its confidence fell below the floor.
